title: Miniature autumn harvest still life for dollhouse in 1:12 scale 4
description: A warm handcrafted miniature autumn scene featuring pumpkins and grapes. Every tiny detail was sculpted and painted by me. All items are securely glued to the base. Perfect for collectors, dollhouse decoration, miniature kitchens, autumn displays, harvest scenes, dioramas, and creative photography. This cozy seasonal arrangement will bring rich color and a warm autumn atmosphere to any miniature interior. Not suitable for children.
